about: Every registry command and every capability of every panel, with the AI tool that covers it or an accepted gap. Gaps: not_built (names the milestone that builds it), needs_pointer (names the tool that takes points instead), writes_into_game (no tool ever covers it), user_only (only the user may do it). tests/test_mcp_coverage.py keeps this file current.
